items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah, yeah, I know Barney all right.

ctx.x: You know him now and see him --
Oh, yeah, yeah, I know Barney all right. But I didn't -- see his uncle you know Emil, but --

He had Donnell Howard on it. Yeah. Clionette, Barney Biggar, Nick. Nick, you know Nick. Clionette, Albert. Had them three guys on Clionette. And Tennant, they all played Tennant. Well, you know, that's what they called. He paid about a thousand dollars there. And they couldn't hit a tap. And they called him where it was loaded. And the man walked up there and said, I'm sorry. He'd have paid us right now.
You stayed out here and there.
